verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates on the stated facts. A is the cheapest and arrives earliest but has an earlier departure and a connection. B offers a little more post-call departure margin at a modest premium, though its hotel-check-in buffer is tighter. C offers the strongest outbound time buffer among the nonstops, while D is cheaper than C and aligned with Javier but arrives 40 minutes later, leaving only 55 minutes before the hotel deadline. The unspecified hotel-transfer time, value of nonstop reliability, tolerance for post-call airport timing, and importance of coordinating with Javier prevent a unique generic selection.
